shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is spring because of the flowers.
I often go hiking on weekends with my friends.
Cooking new recipes is a fun way to relax.
Traveling to different countries expands my worldview.
I love listening to music while studying or working.
Spending time with family is important to me.
Learning a new language can be both challenging and rewarding.
Volunteering in my community helps me feel connected to others.
Finding a balance between work and leisure is essential for happiness.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable trip you've taken?
Q2: What challenges did you face when planning that trip?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of travel in life?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you ever struggled to maintain a regular exercise routine?
Q3: Why do you think exercise is important for health?
Q4: What tips would you offer someone trying to start exercising?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eco-friendly practices.
questions: Q1: Can you describe an eco-friendly practice you follow?
Q2: What difficulties do people face when trying to go green?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is it to protect the environment?
Q4: What recommendations do you have for someone wanting to live more sustainably?
